alerts.header: Rt 1 Detour Hillcrest Farmers Market Every Sun
alerts.description:
Due to the Hillcrest Farmers Market University Avenue will be closed in both directions from Herbert St to Park Bl every Sunday from 5:00am-5:30pm starting on 1/26 to 12/28. 

As a result, the route 1 will be on detour and following stops will be closed:
Eastbound- University Ave at Herbert St (#10494) 
Westbound- University Ave at Normal St (#10865), University Ave at Richmond St (#10862) 

Passengers are advised to board at the following stops: 
Eastbound - University Ave at Richmond St (#10114) or at Park Bl at University Ave (#12804) 
Westbound -University Ave (#11675) or University Ave at Vermont (#11254).
